data.name: AcceleratorAssignment
data.value: The port cannot rewrite an assignment to Accelerator: put a & before the access key's letter in the Caption.

data.name: ValueNotConvertible
data.value: {0} has no RDForms value, so the port leaves it as written.

data.name: ExpressionNotConvertible
data.value: The port converts a value of {0} only when it is a literal or a constant: rewrite this expression with the values of {1}.

data.name: ComputedProgId
data.value: The port rewrites a literal ProgID only: give Controls.Add the name of an RDForms class, such as RDForms.TextBox.

data.name: UnknownProgId
data.value: {0} is not a ProgID the port maps to an RDForms class.

data.name: LateBoundMember
data.value: This late-bound call uses {0}, which the port renames or converts: declare the variable with its control's class so that the port can rewrite the call.

data.name: UnresolvedDataSource
data.value: Nothing resolves {0}: give the form a binding source of that name, or set the property from code.

data.name: ExitPortedToValidate
data.value: This Exit handler is ported to Validate, which is raised only when the control that takes the focus has CausesValidation set to True.

data.name: ScrollBarReference
data.value: A ScrollBar ports to RDForms.HScrollBar or RDForms.VScrollBar by its orientation, so the port types this reference as RDForms.Control.

data.name: UnitWrapped
data.value: The port wrapped this expression in {0} to keep its legacy unit: rewrite it in DIP and remove the call.

data.name: CoordinatesConverted
data.value: The port converts X and Y back to the legacy unit with {0} on this handler's first lines: rewrite the handler in DIP and remove them.

data.name: ScrollBarTypeNameChanged
data.value: This control is a {0} after the port, so its TypeName is no longer ScrollBar: compare it with {0}.

data.name: FindWindowThunderDFrame
data.value: {0} looks for a UserForm's window by its class, ThunderDFrame. A ported form is an RDForms window, so the call finds none: to change the form's icon, set its Icon property.
